# AI工具与模型HOT

> New models, new tools — only the few worth opening, every day.
> AI工具与模型HOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in English with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/
> Language: English (en). The Chinese version lives at the site root.
> Updated: 2026-11-17

## About

- About: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/about.html
- Topics: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/daily.html
- Hot list: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/hot.html
- All items: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/all.html
- RSS feed: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/sitemap.xml

## Machine-readable data

- https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/data/hot.json
- https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/data/daily.json
- https://staroltest.github.io/ai-tool-model-hot/en/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Model releases
- New tools
- Guides & tutorials
- Industry news
- Open source
- Reviews & comparisons

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
